Payout of 8 July is short ₹4,409.63.
The bank credited ₹1,72,017.94 against an expected ₹1,76,427.57. 23 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000061 of ₹4,409.63, issued 16 August against payment pay_000569. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000061 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000061 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
